original_sentence: It'll probably be a very long time before we see a five-star robot-chef, says Noel Sharkey, professor of AI and robotics at the University of Sheffield.
translation: 谢菲尔德大学人工智能与机器人学教授 Noel Sharkey 表示，可能还要很久我们才会看到五星级机器人厨师。

five-star robot-chef 在本句中对应"五星级机器人厨师"。
